name: Verifed V14.3
description: Added 40 individually source-matched food photos across Fresh Kitchen, Reyes, Monroe, Strand, Osprey, Stubborn Mule, Lazy Moon, Pig Floyds, Woodlands, Winter Park Biscuit Company, Bombay Street Kitchen and Tin & Taco. Per-item coverage increased to 307 of 1,630 catalog entries; remaining item images cannot safely be guessed. All 25 restaurants already have hero imagery. GitHub-only update.
verification: Image registry matches photos to exact catalog item keys, preserving the rule against unrelated photos on menu cards.
29 new Fresh Kitchen menu asset references use AVIF and have neutral fallbacks if a device cannot display them.
External links are monitored in CI but may expire; many menu items remain without individually verified images.
Photos do not certify ingredients, allergen safety, availability or permissions for commercial redistribution.
